columns.name: segment
columns.description: The segment the customer belongs to.

columns.name: the_largest_total_cost_of_products_in_a_single_order
columns.description: The largest total cost of products in a single order the customer has made.

columns.name: name_of_the_product_that_was_ordered_recently
columns.description: The name of the product that was ordered most recently by the customer, with ties broken by the ascending order of the product name.

columns.name: item_ordered_with_the_highest_quantity_in_the_East_region
columns.description: The item ordered with the highest quantity in the East region by the customer, with ties broken by the descending order of the product name.

columns.name: number_of_orders_in_2016_from_the_east_superstore
columns.description: The number of orders in 2016 from the East region superstore by the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: number_of_orders_with_more_than_3_kinds_of_products_ordered
columns.description: The number of orders with more than 3 kinds of products ordered by the customer, replace NULL values with 0.

models.name: products
models.description: Each record represents a product in a specific region.

columns.name: product_name
columns.description: The name of the product in its region.

columns.name: total_profits
columns.description: The total profits of the product in its region, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: has_a_profit_greater_than_98_per_of_the_average_profit_of_all_products_in_the_East_region
columns.description: Set to 1 if the profit of the product is greater than 98% of the average profit of all products in the East region, 0 otherwise. Only applicable when region is 'East'; always Null for other regions.

columns.name: percetange_of_consumers_among_the_customers
columns.description: The percentage of consumers among the customers who have ordered the product in its region.

columns.name: is_ordered_by_Becky_Martin_around_the_Central_region
columns.description: Set to 1 if the product is ordered by Becky Martin in the Central region, 0 otherwise. Only applicable when region is 'Central'; always 0 for other regions.

columns.name: total_quantity_sold
columns.description: The total quantity sold of the product in its region, replace NULL values with 0.
